record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Stop staring at a blank slide.

AI Slides helps you create a complete PPT-style presentation from a prompt, an outline, or your notes — in minutes. It’s built for people who need a strong first draft fast, then want full control to polish the story.


WHY PEOPLE USE AI SLIDES
• You have the content, but not the time to format slides
• You need a clear structure (agenda, sections, key points)
• You want decks that look consistent (theme + layout)
• You’re making “one more presentation” for school, work, or a pitch


HOW IT WORKS
1) Start with a topic, prompt, or pasted notes
2) Choose a style / theme (business, minimal, classroom, pitch)
3) Generate a structured deck (title, agenda, sections, summary)
4) Edit slide-by-slide, reorder, then present


PROMPT IDEAS (COPY/PASTE)
• “Create a 10-slide pitch deck for a fitness app”
• “Turn these notes into a class presentation with 6 sections”
• “Make an executive update deck: goals, progress, risks, next steps”
• “Summarise this report into slide-ready bullets”


WHAT YOU CAN MAKE
• Pitch decks: problem → solution → market → traction → ask
• School presentations: clean sections and speaker-friendly bullets
• Meeting decks: updates, plans, next steps, and action items
• Reports → slides: turn long text into slide headings and bullets


FEATURES
• AI presentation generator from text, outlines, and notes
• Slide structure that reads well when presenting (not walls of text)
• Templates and themes for consistent design across the whole deck
• Quick editing on iPhone: adjust titles, bullets, and flow in seconds
• Export and share your deck (PPTX/PDF) so it fits real workflows
• Create multiple versions fast (short, detailed, or “executive summary”)


QUALITY AND CONTROL
AI gives you a draft; you stay in charge:
• shorten slides
• rewrite sections for your audience
• change slide order to improve narrative flow
• swap themes to match your context


PRIVACY
We only process what’s needed to generate your slides. You can delete drafts and decks anytime. We don’t sell personal data. See our Privacy Policy for details.


Download AI Slides and make your next presentation the easy one.


TIPS FOR BETTER DECKS
• Paste an outline with headings to control slide structure
• Ask for the number of slides you need (e.g., 8–12)
• Specify the audience (students, executives, investors)
• Keep each slide to one key idea — you can always expand later

record.offering: Utilities app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Presentations that travel with you.

Slaide turns a plain-text file into a polished presentation — and this app puts the whole thing in your hand. Open a deck, fix a line, and present it full-screen from your phone or iPad.

Everything you need to work on a deck

Open any .slaide file or .slaidec bundle and see it exactly as it renders everywhere else — same fonts, same layouts, same theme. Edit the words, swap an image, reorder slides, tighten a headline in the taxi. Present full-screen with speaker notes on your device while the audience sees only the slides. Export to PDF or an editable PowerPoint file and send it from wherever you are.

Build a new deck from a sentence (paid account)

Describe what you need and Slaide writes it — structure, headlines, supporting points, all laid out in your theme. It checks its own work, renders the result, and fixes what doesn't fit before handing it to you. A pitch on the train. A workshop outline between meetings. A client update you'd otherwise have written at midnight.

Your design, applied automatically

A Slaide theme is a reusable master: fonts, colors, spacing and layouts defined once. Every slide you write or generate arrives already on-brand, so there's no dragging text boxes on a touchscreen — the one job phones have always been bad at.

One source, every format

The same file becomes a web deck, a print-ready PDF and a real PowerPoint file with editable text boxes and shapes. Nothing is flattened into pictures, and nothing drifts between formats.

It's plain text, so it's yours

A deck is a small text file you can read, diff, back up and keep. Slaide's core format is open source under Apache-2.0. If you ever stop using us, your decks still open.

Practice your presentation with a coach

Want to run through your presentation before you hold it? Slaide has a built in coach that times you and gives you feedback on how well you are hitting the points from the slide. Let it help you find your perfect pitch.

Works with decks made in the Slaide desktop app or CLI, so what you build at your desk is on your phone when you need it.
